description: No figure the cloth will hold

participation.context: Refused a share for the page, kept the twenty pounds off the cloth, and would not open the coffer.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Would not give a figure the cloth does not hold, and would not strike a share.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Asked for a number, was refused, and kept the Mayor's sentence.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Brought the close into the parlour, and her sentence with it.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Took a day without a sum, and set the shut door beside Thursday's two dogs.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

relations.quote: I was not in it, John.
I will sit the middle again, Tom.

story.body: You reckoned with Heminges, Kemp, Burbage and Pope. No share, no figure, Monday still to play. Kemp heard her sentence from Burbage and kept a form of it. You went home to your own book.

relations.quote: I was not in it, John.
I will sit the middle again, Tom.

title: Heard Heminges refuse a figure and a share
